hotspots.title: Trump vs. Mainstream Media Conflict
hotspots.blurb: A federal judge ordered the White House to temporarily restore press access for CNN, MS NOW, and Politico following a ban imposed by the Trump administration. The legal confrontation has ignited intense debate over First Amendment rights, presidential power, and media access.
hotspots.affect: High constitutional stakes and allegations of presidential press censorship generate outrage, polarized legal battles, and aggressive media framing.

hotspots.title: Trump's High-Stakes Xi Jinping Summit
hotspots.blurb: President Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping for a high-profile state visit featuring tech CEOs, concluding with a two-month trade truce but no major structural breakthroughs. Coverage highlights the tension between lavish ceremonial honors and unresolved disputes over trade, AI, and regional influence.
hotspots.affect: Framed around geopolitical anxiety, high-stakes trade diplomacy, and economic nationalist competition between rival superpowers.

hotspots.title: Trump Administration's Policy Controversies and Legal Challenges
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration faces a cascade of legal actions and judicial pushback over policy moves, including revisions to the Endangered Species Act, third-country deportations, and offshore wind lease cancellations. Multiple state attorneys general and federal courts are actively blocking executive actions across environmental and social domains.
hotspots.affect: Commanded by aggressive legal confrontation, environmental alarmism, and deep ideological disputes over administrative power.

hotspots.title: Political Polarization and Trump's Power Dynamics
hotspots.blurb: Trump is launching a high-visibility swing of midterm campaign rallies in Oklahoma and Alabama while scheduling appearances at major sporting events like college football games. Reports highlight strong base enthusiasm contrasted with logistical friction and political polarization generated by his presence.
hotspots.affect: Sustained by grassroots campaign enthusiasm, base mobilization, and populist power projection ahead of upcoming elections.

hotspots.title: Pro-Tech Deregulation and USD Economic Dominance Strategy
hotspots.blurb: The administration is pushing key economic and tech strategy initiatives, including intervening against EU regulatory fines on Elon Musk's X, planning USD-backed global stablecoins, and accelerating AI integration. These policies spark friction with international regulators as well as internal debate within conservative ranks.
hotspots.affect: Driven by grievances against foreign regulatory overreach, technocratic power plays, and intra-movement tension over technology adoption.
